evals.name: finish-accepted-spec
evals.prompt: /spec-finish 001 — I'm not available to answer questions during this run: for anything open, take your recommended answer, record it as a decision, and treat your summary as confirmed — don't wait for me. The remote is a local bare repository, so there is no GitHub: when the pull request can't be opened, give me its title and body.
evals.expected_output: Memory updated from the templates, the Subtracting numbers section marked as implemented, the spec archived as finished/<14 digits>-001-subtract, one finish commit, the branch pushed, and the PR title and body.
assertions: the spec is archived in .specs/finished/<YYYYMMDDHHMMSS>-001-subtract with status finished
structure.md exists and the preflight passes (no template leftovers)
requirements.md marks Subtracting numbers as implemented in spec 001-subtract
one finish commit and a clean tree
the branch is pushed to origin
the CI gate (check-pr.mjs) passes on the branch
the final message gives a pull request title naming spec 001
